fusions.name: Pounce From Cover
fusions.desc: A pouncing gore on a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 22 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Swishing Tail
fusions.desc: A lashing swish of your tail that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave each [Damped] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Lost in the Herd
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. Its effect increases by 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Four Hooves Down
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
